CustomField.formula: IF(TEXT(Flight_Type_Code__c) = 'Domestic', IF( DPR_Reported_Date__c - datevalue(/* Year Logic */ MID(Arrival_Date_Time__c, 7,4) +'-'+ /* Month Logic */ MID(Arrival_Date_Time__c, FIND("/",Arrival_Date_Time__c) + 1, FIND("/",Arrival_Date_Time__c, FIND("/",Arrival_Date_Time__c) + 1) - FIND("/",Arrival_Date_Time__c) - 1 )+'-'+ /* Day Logic */ LEFT(Arrival_Date_Time__c, FIND("/",Arrival_Date_Time__c) - 1)) < 4, true, false), IF(TEXT(Flight_Type_Code__c) = 'International', IF(DPR_Reported_Date__c - datevalue(/* Year Logic */ MID(Arrival_Date_Time__c, 7,4) +'-'+ /* Month Logic */ MID(Arrival_Date_Time__c, FIND("/",Arrival_Date_Time__c) + 1, FIND("/",Arrival_Date_Time__c, FIND("/",Arrival_Date_Time__c) + 1) - FIND("/",Arrival_Date_Time__c) - 1 )+'-'+ /* Day Logic */ LEFT(Arrival_Date_Time__c, FIND("/",Arrival_Date_Time__c) - 1)) < 8, true, false), false))
CustomField.label: Within Timeframe?
